crossRefs.note: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

parallels.note: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

translations.web: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk after its kind,
translations.bsb: the ostrich, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
translations.kjv: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
translations.asv: and the ostrich, and the night-hawk, and the sea-mew, and the hawk after its kind,
